contacts.already_linked: That is already linked to an account. Add a different one.
contacts.last_verified_email: This is the only verified address on the account, the one proof it is yours. Verify another before removing this one.
contacts.last_verified_phone: This is the only verified number on the account. Verify another before removing this one.
contacts.limit_email: An account holds {count} email addresses. Remove one to add another.
contacts.limit_phone: An account holds {count} phone numbers. Remove one to add another.
contacts.not_verified_email: Verify this address before making it primary.
contacts.not_verified_phone: Verify this number before making it primary.
contacts.primary_email: This is your primary address. Make another one primary first.
contacts.primary_phone: This is your primary number. Make another one primary first.
gate.details: Add a few details to carry on.
gate.email_unverified: Verify your email address to carry on.
gate.phone_unverified: Verify your mobile number to carry on.
proof.required: This needs your password, or a sign-in with Google or Apple, in the last {minutes} minutes, and your two-factor code if two-factor is on.
roles.last_owner: This is the organisation's only owner. Make someone else an owner first.
organisation.owner_required: Only an owner can delete the organisation.
organisation.transfer_owner_required: Only an owner can transfer ownership.
organisation.delete_name_mismatch: Type {name} exactly as shown to delete it.
roles.grant_not_held: You can only grant, remove or move people onto permissions your own role holds. Nothing was changed.
roles.name_builtin: Built-in roles cannot be renamed. You can still change what this one holds.
roles.name_taken: A role with that name already exists.
roles.name_too_long: Shorten the name to {count} characters or fewer.
roles.owner_fixed: Owner is built in and cannot be changed or removed. It always has everything.
roles.permission_unknown: Soirely has no permission by that name. Reload the page and try again.
roles.replacement_invalid: Choose another role in this organisation.
roles.replacement_required: Choose the role these people move to.
roles.seeded_kept: Built-in roles cannot be removed, but you can change what they hold. If nobody needs this one, leave it unassigned.
validation.code_app_or_recovery_required: Enter a code from your app, or a recovery code.
validation.code_app_required: Enter the 6-digit code from your app.
validation.code_email_required: Enter the 6-digit code from the email.
validation.code_text_required: Enter the 6-digit code from the text.
validation.contact_address_invalid: That does not look like an email address. Check it has an @ and a domain.
validation.event_end_before_start: The end is before the start. Choose a later end.
validation.event_name_too_long: Use at most {count} characters for the name.
validation.event_time_invalid: Enter a date and a time with no time zone offset.
validation.locale_invalid: Choose English, Español, Français or Português.
validation.password_breached: This password has appeared in a known data breach. Choose another.
validation.password_unchanged: That is already your password. Choose a different one.
validation.phone_invalid: That is not a mobile number for {country}. Check it and try again.
validation.phone_too_long: That number looks too long for {country}. Check it and try again.
validation.phone_too_short: That number looks too short for {country}. Check it and try again.
validation.recovery_code_required: Enter one of your recovery codes.
validation.timezone_unknown: That time zone isn't one we know, so nothing was saved. Choose one from the list.
members.already_a_member: That person is already a member of this organisation.
members.already_a_member_named: {email} is already a member of {organisation}. Change their role from their row in Members instead.
invitations.not_found: We could not find that invitation. Check the link in the email.
invitations.not_yours: This invitation is for a different email address.
invitations.email_taken: That email address already has a Soirely account. Sign in with it, and you can accept the invitation there.
invitations.not_pending: Only a pending invitation can be withdrawn.
invitations.organisation_deleted: This organisation no longer exists, so the invitation cannot be accepted.
invitations.accepted: This invitation has already been accepted.
invitations.expired: This invitation has expired. Ask whoever invited you to send a new one.
validation.invite_email_invalid: That does not look like an email address. Check it has an @ and a domain.
members.own_membership: You cannot change your own role or remove yourself. Another owner or administrator can, or you can leave from General.
domain_joining.domain_full: That is {count} domains, the most the list can hold. Remove one to add another.
domain_joining.domain_invalid: Enter a domain with a dot and no spaces, like {example}.
domain_joining.domain_not_yours: Add a domain your own address is at.
domain_joining.domain_proved_elsewhere: Another organisation has proved {domain} on Enterprise, so only its listing works.
domain_joining.domain_public: You cannot use a public email domain.
domain_joining.not_listed: That domain is not on the list.
domain_joining.unavailable: You cannot ask to join that organisation. Start your own, or ask somebody there to invite you.
